scenarios: Actual /sw.js activates in Chrome and acknowledges a real MessageChannel account binding
DevTools delivers to the actual worker; native showNotification resolves with expected content and routing
Repeated notification ID passes the same replacement tag to native showNotification
Wrong account/tenant, unscoped and malformed messages are suppressed by the actual worker
Clearing the persisted account suppresses queued old-account delivery
Unsafe external notification target is replaced with the same-origin application root
Account switch permits native showNotification only for the new recipient
delivery: Chrome DevTools ServiceWorker.deliverPushMessage -> actual /sw.js -> native showNotification
limitations: Synthetic DevTools delivery bypasses Web Push provider, encryption and VAPID.
This Windows headless Chrome returned no getNotifications records after native showNotification resolved; visual replacement and closing are covered by VM tests only.
Headless native API success does not prove a visible OS notification or sound.
Trusted user notification clicks are covered by VM handler tests, not an OS click in this harness.
